lines.text: Many learners say: My new boss is very sympathetic.
Better: My new boss is very nice.
Say nice for a kind person.
Nice! My friend is very nice.

data.wrong: My new boss is very sympathetic.
data.right: My new boss is very nice.
data.why: Say nice for a kind person.

quiz.stem: My friend is very ___. She helps everyone.

native.tip: Не “sympathetic”, а “nice”: “My new boss is very nice.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “My new boss is very sympathetic”? 😅 Русское «симпатичный» похоже на sympathetic, но это слово значит «сочувствующий». Для «приятный человек» нужно “nice.” Правильно: “My new boss is very nice.” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “nice.” Приятный человек — nice. Напиши своё предложение с “is very nice.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: Not “sympathetic” but “nice”: “My new boss is very nice.”
en.caption: Do you also say “My new boss is very sympathetic”? 😅 The Russian word for nice looks like “sympathetic,” but that word means feeling sorry for someone. For a pleasant person you need “nice.” Correct: “My new boss is very nice.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
